about: 2026-11-22 lumberjack5: the user's correction (verbatim: 'I believe it's the same button to pick them up from the ground'): a lumberjack who has his man in a REAR grapple turns him to a front one with R, the pick-up button, before the roll-in's walk and throw -- never the C-up shoulder lift. CPU against CPU; the second competitor walks out every 30 s (qa_lj_out), and the roller grabs him from behind on purpose (qa_lj_behind) so the turn is shown. The game's log has a line for each hold from behind and each turn (grab flags, states, how far the two face apart).
